comment: Read from the maker's source at 2.6.1, commit e6a0c67. Each knob maps 0 to 1 onto -5V to 5V, the CV is added, the picked value is clamped to ±5V and then scaled by range/5 and clamped again to the range switch's own limit of 2.5, 5 or 10 volts. The bus is a plain sum of the engaged channels; the Average jack divides that sum by four rather than by the number of channels engaged. The slew rate on the Slew jack is held in the module and set outside process, so no figure is quoted.
